description: Find off-market parcels in a Colorado or Virginia county, town or ZIP from county records: who is likely to sell and why. Pick a trade for a buyer's list: wholesaler (absentee owners, held 10+ years, bought for under half of today's value), flipper (dated homes next to updated sales), str_investor (mountain-town homes with absentee owners), developer (land is most of the value), cash_investor and brrr (rent against value), land (empty lots), two_households (a family compound: room for two households), realtor (estate, tax lien, code case or stalled permit). Returns parcels with address, county value, last sale, years held and a shinnslist link; never owner names.

county.description: County name as the county files it, for example Boulder, Larimer, Weld, Jefferson, Adams, Broomfield, Summit, Eagle, Grand (Colorado) or Henrico, Chesterfield (Virginia).

duplex_ok.description: Zoning allows a duplex on the lot by right.

limit.description: How many parcels to return, at most 25 (default 10).

max_drive_city_mins.description: At most this many minutes by road to the nearest city.

max_drive_town_mins.description: At most this many minutes by road to the nearest town with a grocery store.

max_finished_sf.description: At most this many finished square feet.

max_tenure.description: Held at most this many years.

max_value.description: The county value is at most this many dollars.

max_year_built.description: Built in this year or earlier.

min_beds.description: At least this many bedrooms on the assessor's record.

min_finished_sf.description: At least this many finished square feet.

min_tenure.description: Held at least this many years since the last recorded sale.

min_value.description: The county value is at least this many dollars.

min_year_built.description: Built in this year or later.

state.description: CO or VA. Optional when county or zip is given.

teardown.description: A teardown: an old or small house on land worth most of the value.

town.description: A Colorado or Virginia town or city name, for example Lyons or Estes Park. Matched to the parcels within about five miles of the town.

trade.description: The buyer's trade: one of the doors above. Omit for every parcel in the area.

water_rights.description: Colorado only: a decreed water right whose point of diversion is on the lot. Virginia has no water rights to own.

wells.description: Colorado only: a well permit on the lot.

name: find_parcels
title: Find off-market parcels
